firmwares.about: Custom FM-1 firmware that turns the synth into a hardware control surface for CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ...) driven by the agtdeck.py host daemon: agent states on the key LEDs and screen, approve / deny / interrupt from the transport buttons. It is a controller with no synth engine; without its daemon it waits for the host. The demo link plays a scripted session by itself: daemon frames in, the GRID as a list and as boxes, every page walked.
firmwares.author: Kevin Elliott
firmwares.name: Agent Deck

note: Agent Deck player: a vendored fm1-emu (MIT) whose whole catalog is Agent Deck. The package sits beside this file and is fetched same-origin. See README.md in this folder.
